Evidence:
[1] In the episode, Butters survives a murder attempt by his own mother after discovering his father's homosexual dalliances and must travel back to South Park in time for his parents' wedding anniversary at Bennigan's.
[2] The wedding of Prince William, Duke of Cambridge, and Catherine Middleton took place on 29 April 2011 at Westminster Abbey in London, United Kingdom.
[3] "Royal Pudding" is the third episode of the fifteenth season of the American animated television series "South Park", and the 212th episode of the series overall.
